name: translate-distill-v1: full fine-tuning of opus-mt-tc-bible-big-roa-en (233M) on jargon-aware pairs (datasets/bad_english/translate-jargon-v1)

authorization.scope: one run plus at most one corrective rerun

hypotheses.H1: Learning: on the 226 natural messages (425 sentences) the fine-tuned model is good enough (S0-S2 by the worse of Grok and GLM, same judges and prompt as translate-compare) on a share above opus-biblebig base (44.2%) with a paired bootstrap 95% lower bound above 0.
hypotheses.H2: Jargon retention: span retention (hasSpan on the detector spans of the natural sentences) of the fine-tuned model is above the base (and above the base with quoting).
hypotheses.H3: Closeness: the fine-tuned model reaches at least 55% (Qwen3-4B Q8 62.6%) to be called close; otherwise the recommendation is no chain change.
hypotheses.H4: No over-preservation: on dev clean rows (no jargon) exact-match share is not lower than the base by more than 3 points.
hypotheses.H5: Speed: CPU median latency per sentence (4 threads, greedy) within 1.3x of the base; int8 CTranslate2 export reported if it needs no install.

recipe.method: full fine-tuning, fp32 master weights with bf16 autocast, AdamW lr 3e-5, weight decay 0.01, batch 32, 5 epochs max, warmup 5%, linear decay, max_length 400, seed 42

stopping_rules.interim_checks: two per epoch: dev loss, greedy decode of 200 fixed dev rows (jargon-term retention, exact matches), greedy decode of 31 fixed natural sentences (read-only, only the non-empty count enters the rules)
stopping_rules.failing: after epoch 1: dev jargon retention below 50% or fewer than half of the natural outputs non-empty -> stop, keep no model
stopping_rules.plateau: dev loss above its best at two consecutive checks -> stop, best checkpoint (lowest dev loss) is selected
stopping_rules.selection: lowest dev loss; the natural sample is never used for selection

corrective_rerun: Allowed once, for a data or hyperparameter defect found by these rules; a larger dataset (toward ~30,000 rows, DeepSeek cost about 2-5 USD, stop at 10 USD) only if the first stage helps.
non_claim: Not a claim about unseen jargon beyond the 160 held-out terms; targets are LLM-written and unreviewed; judges are correlated.
